prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Create ONE emotionally moving and hopeful visual novel CG, opaque landscape 16:9, target 1920x1080. The five travelers are ALREADY INSIDE the TARDIS, saying their last goodbye to Jessy, who STAYS OUTSIDE on the Capitol square for 999 years. They carry humanity's hope. Theo raises his thumb to promise that they will return. A tender goodbye full of courage, not a party and not a funeral.

REFERENCES, not edit targets:
1 tardis_depart_character_references.png is the STRICT six-character likeness and CURRENT OUTFIT sheet. Top row: THEO, JESSY, ALLAN. Bottom row: MICKA, SOFIANE, FLORENTIN. Reference labels are identification only, do not reproduce sheet layout or labels.
2 09_sauvetage.png establishes THIS TARDIS: dark blue wooden double doors, much larger warm golden/bronze circular interior with console and tall illuminated central time rotor. Reuse the spacecraft interior design, but NONE of the disaster, refugees or Laplage from that image.
3 14_calin_jessy_theo.png establishes exact emotional facial rendering, youthful short-bearded Jessy, older grey-moustached Theo and luminous sunset continuity immediately before this shot. Same tender feeling.
4 capitole_depart.png establishes the outdoor bronze Capitol square, ceremonial crowd and two-sun sunset light, only a peripheral glimpse outside if needed.

CHARACTERS, exact count SIX men total: five inside, ONE outside.
THEO inside front-center, principal focal point, mature approximately sixty, swept GREY hair, grey moustache, rectangular black GLASSES, beige coat and charcoal turtleneck, small green creeper keychain clipped to coat. His RIGHT hand gives an unmistakable upright THUMBS UP toward Jessy at chest height, anatomically clear single thumb and curled fingers; eyes moist, reassuring bittersweet smile. He is the leader offering a promise to his friend, no open-palm wave for him.
ALLAN inside to Theo's left, short silver hair, short silver beard, dark aviator glasses, formal charcoal grey business suit, white shirt and grey patterned tie, brown leather gloves. No officer cap or cape. Gentle proud smile and a small goodbye wave toward Jessy.
MICKA inside near Allan, swept grey hair, short grey beard, NO glasses, dark fine-pinstripe three-piece governor suit, white shirt, muted burgundy patterned tie. No combat armor. He waves with an affectionate smile, visibly touched.
SOFIANE inside to Theo's right, dark hair tied in a small ponytail with grey at temples, black rectangular glasses, short salt-and-pepper beard, simple black zip jacket, charcoal T-shirt and trousers. No spacesuit. Reserved warm smile and small raised farewell hand.
FLORENTIN inside farther right, silver hair and short silver beard, rectangular glasses and diagonal cheek scar, deep green and black futuristic armor with gold edging and small amber accents. No helmet, no weapon. A solemn affectionate hand raised goodbye, relieved hopeful expression.
JESSY outside at the threshold, FOREGROUND RIGHT in a readable three-quarter BACK/PROFILE view: the ONE young adult, chestnut tousled hair, SHORT brown beard and moustache, rectangular black glasses, simple ivory white PRIEST robe with upright collar, NO very long beard, NO red gemstone pendant. He has not aged. We see enough of his near eye and face to see a tear and a brave small smile. His hand lifted toward the five friends, a restrained farewell. He is NOT boarding and is on the OUTSIDE of the door sill, the sole white-robed man.

CAMERA AND STAGING: medium-wide cinematic view from just outside/at the open doorway, slightly behind and to the side of Jessy, looking inward so we see all FIVE travelers' faces and the unmistakably vast TARDIS interior behind them. The open blue door leaves and sill frame the shot at the outer left/right margins; we are close enough to the opening that the five distinct men are large enough to recognize, occupying the middle two-thirds. No need to show the whole small exterior booth. Jessy's near shoulder and profile at the right edge form an emotional foreground counterpoint, not a silhouette blocking the group. All five travelers stand within the same clearly connected interior behind the sill, staggered naturally in a loose shallow arc, not pasted portrait sprites or a flat line. Theo is nearest the doorway, everyone looking toward Jessy. Five different visible farewell gestures, all hands attached naturally and not overlapping faces. One friend's free hand may rest gently on another's shoulder in solidarity.
Behind travelers, glimpse the round bronze console and glowing central time rotor, concentric metal beams, round illuminated wall insets and a few curved steps receding into a room impossibly larger than its blue door. Keep console from hiding bodies or faces. A couple of small travel bags at floor level only. The TARDIS is not traveling yet: open doorway onto the SAME physical square, no portal or time vortex.

LIGHT AND EMOTION: warm golden hour from square mixes with soft honey-amber console light, cool blue doorframe accents, subtle rim light on grey hair and Jessy's white robe. Luminous, painterly, human warmth and promise, smiling through sadness. Their decision serves the future of everyone who remains outside. Background crowd if visible only as tiny out-of-focus peripheral silhouettes, never additional large passengers. Show intimate trust inside a grand science-fiction setting.
STYLE: finished detailed illustrated anime visual novel CG, fine confident dark outlines, nuanced expressive faces, softly painted cel shading, textured fabric and bronze, rich coherent perspective and cinematic depth, same quality as the reference CGs. Not photorealistic, not caricature, not chibi.
COMPOSITION SAFETY: all SIX faces, Theo's raised thumb and farewell hands fully visible in UPPER TWO THIRDS, lower 25-28 percent quieter natural coats and flooring reserved for game dialogue overlay. Do not put Theo's thumb at the bottom.
Single cohesive full-frame illustration. No text, readable signs, captions, speech balloons, UI, border, watermark, collage or panels. No Laplage, Alexandre, Ilona or other large characters. No duplicate men, no long-bearded Jessy, no grey-haired Jessy, no TAIKUN, no futuristic battle uniforms on Allan/Micka/Sofiane, no explosions, guns, ghost figures, magic portals, warp tunnel or battle.
